extension.summary: Send what you watch in Kodi to Seenr
Envoie vers Seenr ce que tu regardes dans Kodi
extension.description: Marks movies and episodes as watched on Seenr as you play them in Kodi. The add-on runs inside the player, so it knows the real playback position: nothing to confirm afterwards. Paste the connection URL from your Seenr settings (Account, Auto-tracking, Kodi) and you are done.

Coche sur Seenr les films et épisodes que tu lances dans Kodi. L'add-on tourne dans le lecteur, donc il connaît la vraie position de lecture : rien à confirmer ensuite. Colle l'URL de connexion depuis tes réglages Seenr (Compte, Auto-suivi, Kodi), c'est tout.
extension.news: 1.0.2 - First submission to the official repository - Marks movies and episodes as watched on Seenr as they are played, with the real playback position - Sends the stop of a title still loaded when Kodi closes, so nothing stays "in progress" - No analytics, no ads, no paid feature inside the add-on
